# Fence after the storm

- On the night of Tuesday 3 November, in the storm, one panel of the fence between our back garden and no. 14's blew out. The posts on either side are still standing.
- Our neighbour at no. 14 is Mr Aziz. We have only ever waved to each other.
- I am at home on Saturday 14 November from 10 to 12 and could meet him in the garden to look at the gap.
- We would like it mended before the end of the month, as our dog can get through the gap.
